visual_review.findings: The exact PNG has a clear single Treasury line, percent axis, January 2-November 4, 2026 window and a legend identifying the final 4.90% observation. The visible early-year trough, autumn high and subsequent decline agree with the source-bound row sequence; all 212 date/value pairs were compared by code against the admitted document. The one-series geometry is internally consistent, without a second axis, clipped data, fabricated forecast extension or Bitcoin overlay. The title, wrapped subtitle, tick labels and Treasury/Capital Chronicle credit are readable and do not overlap at the inspected full size. The rightmost tick dates the endpoint. The attached caption and alt text explicitly say this is not Bitcoin performance. Dense daily markers are acceptable for the full-history chart; the final destination render must retain readable sizing or use the planned article-bound card for compact presentation.
